letter.title: Payment Demand Letter
letter.disclaimer: This letter is from {business} about money owed for the invoices listed below. It is not a notice from the GST department and not a legal notice from a lawyer.
letter.subject: Subject: Payment due on the invoices listed below
letter.intro: Dear {customer}, our records show that the following invoices from {business} remain unpaid after their due dates.
letter.dispute_contact: If you believe anything here is wrong, please contact {contact} before the deadline.
letter.msmed_line: {business} is a Udyam-registered {cls} enterprise (Udyam No. {udyam}). Under the MSMED Act, 2006, buyers should pay micro and small suppliers within the agreed period, which cannot exceed 45 days, and interest applies on late payment.
letter.interest_heading: Interest under section 16 of the MSMED Act, 2006 (shown separately)
letter.interest_not_added: This interest is shown for information and is not added to the amount demanded above.
letter.interest_added: This interest is added to the amount demanded above.
letter.interest_conventions: Worked out at three times the RBI Bank Rate in force on each day, compounded with monthly rests from the due date; days counted actual/365; part payments applied to interest first (Gurpreet Singh v. Union of India, SC 2006); no interest for periods where a dispute was accepted.
letter.closing: Thank you for your prompt attention.
letter.verify_caption: Scan to check this letter is genuine and unaltered
print.einvoice_note: E-invoicing applies (turnover above ₹5 crore): IRN to be generated on the government portal.
print.composition_note: Composition taxable person, not eligible to collect tax on supplies

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: Designed to DPDP principles. Data-fiduciary duties under the DPDP Act 2023 are not yet in force; this is voluntary early compliance.
privacy.data_map: What we hold about each customer, and why
privacy.data_name: Name, address, GSTIN — required on GST invoices
privacy.data_contact: Email and phone — to send invoices and payment updates
privacy.data_history: Invoice and payment history — to track what is owed
privacy.retention_rule: GST law requires invoice records to be kept for 72 months from 31 December after the financial year. FY 2026-27 records: until {date}.
privacy.optouts: Customers who asked us to stop messages: {n}
privacy.anonymize_hint: Name and contact details are replaced; the invoice ledger stays, as GST law requires (DPDP Act s.8(7)).
privacy.notice_log: Privacy notices shown on pay pages: {n} (last on {date})
privacy.dates: DPDP timeline: 13 Nov 2025 (Board), 13 Nov 2026 (consent managers), 13 May 2027 (fiduciary duties).

ops.status.title: Reminder system status
ops.status.subtitle: Proof that FullPay sends reminders on its own, every day at 10:00 IST. No customer details are shown on this page.
ops.status.next_run_note: Scheduled runs follow the real calendar. The demo clock only moves the demo date.
ops.status.hero_none: No run yet. The first automatic run is at 10:00 IST.

ops.status.run_id.label: Run ID
ops.status.run_id.hint: A unique name for this run. Every message and record it created carries the same ID, so you can trace them.

ops.status.workflow_id.label: Render Workflow run
ops.status.workflow_id.hint: The ID Render gives the scheduled job that started this run. It matches the run row in the Render dashboard.

ops.status.chain_title.label: Record check
ops.status.chain_title.hint: Every action is sealed into a hash chain: each record carries a SHA-256 fingerprint of the one before it, so changing any past record breaks every fingerprint after it.

ops.status.chain_ok: Record unaltered · {n} records checked just now
ops.status.chain_broken: Record altered: the chain breaks at record {id}
ops.status.empty_body: The first automatic run happens at 10:00 IST. It will show up here with its run ID and counts.
ops.status.mail_test: Test mode: every email goes to the owner's own inbox
ops.status.mail_live: Emails go to customers through Resend
ops.status.mail_off: Email is not set up on this server, so emails are marked 'Could not send' and wait for a retry
ops.status.error_title: Status is not available right now
ops.status.error_body: We could not reach the database. Please try again in a minute.
ops.status.no_pii: This page shows counts and IDs only. No names, amounts, emails or phone numbers.

ops.run.advanced.label: Moved to next step
ops.run.advanced.hint: Bills that moved up one step on the reminder ladder in this run. A bill never moves more than one step a day.

ops.run.letters.label: Letters drafted
ops.run.letters.hint: Payment Demand Letters and next-step guidance are only drafted. They are never sent automatically; the owner decides.

ops.run.held.label: Held back
ops.run.held.hint: Not sent because the bill is paused (a dispute, a promise to pay or an 'already paid' claim), snoozed, the customer opted out, or the customer already got a message today.

ops.runs.title: Daily runs
ops.runs.subtitle: Every run of the reminder ladder, and the messages it created.
ops.runs.run_now_hint: Safe to press twice: a reminder step is never sent twice.
ops.runs.empty_body: The first automatic run happens at 10:00 IST. You can also start one now.
ops.runs.done: Run finished: {advanced} moved to the next step, {emailed} emails, {owner} for you to send.
ops.runs.flushed: Email queue sent: {sent} sent, {failed} could not be sent.
ops.runs.busy: A run is already in progress. Try again in a minute.

pages.set.basis_law: DPDP Act s.17(1)(a) exempts processing necessary to enforce a legal claim; we give notice and honour opt-outs anyway.
pages.docs.intro: Each invoice keeps one record: the invoice, every reminder, payment, reply and letter, each sealed with a hash anyone can check.

collect.err.file_too_large: That file is too large. A bank statement CSV should be under 1 MB.

collect.err.promise_open: A promise to pay is already open for this invoice.
collect.err.promise_broken_before: This customer already broke a promise on this invoice, so reminders keep going.
collect.err.not_pending: This message is already marked as sent.

collect.err.not_open: This invoice is no longer open.
collect.err.already_resolved: Someone already resolved this. Reload to see the latest.
collect.err.over_allocated: The amounts add up to more than the payment, or more than an invoice still owes.
collect.err.no_allocations: Pick at least one invoice for this payment.
collect.err.no_header: This does not look like a bank statement: no Date / Narration / Deposit header row was found.
collect.err.tds_recorded: TDS is already recorded for this payment.
collect.err.unauthorized: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
collect.fu.title: Today's follow-ups
collect.fu.intro: Each card has the message ready in the customer's language. Tap WhatsApp, email or SMS to open your own app with it filled in, send it, then tap Mark as sent so it is logged.
collect.fu.empty_next: All caught up. Next reminder is due on {date}
collect.fu.empty_none: All caught up. Nothing is due
collect.fu.empty_body: Reminders appear here on the day the follow-up plan says they are due. Promises to pay and disputes pause them.
collect.fu.tap_hint: Send it from your phone first, then tap Mark as sent.
collect.fu.after_tap: Opened {channel}. Once you have sent it, tap Mark as sent.
collect.fu.auto_note: This one goes out by email automatically at the next send run. Nothing to do.
collect.fu.failed_why: The email did not go through (tries: {n}).
collect.fu.retry_failed: Still not sent. Send it from your phone and tap Mark as sent.
collect.fu.rules: At most one message per customer per day. Nothing is sent for a disputed, paused or opted-out invoice. Payment Demand Letters are never sent automatically.
collect.promise.title: Customer promised to pay
collect.promise.effect_move: This pauses reminders and moves {amount} from {from} into week {to} of the cash forecast.
collect.promise.effect_same: This pauses reminders. {amount} stays in week {to} of the cash forecast.
collect.promise.effect_into: This pauses reminders and puts {amount} into week {to} of the cash forecast.
collect.promise.resume: If the date passes unpaid, reminders start again on their own.
collect.call.title: Call {customer}
collect.call.why: The final reminder has gone. A short, polite call now usually works better than another message.
collect.call.line1: Namaste, this is {owner} from {business}. Am I speaking with someone at {customer}?
collect.call.line2: I am calling about invoice {number} for {amount}, which was due on {due}.
collect.call.line3: It is now {days} days past the due date. Is anything holding the payment up?
collect.call.line4: If something on the invoice is wrong, tell me and I will sort it out today.
collect.call.line5: Could you give me a date by which you can pay? I will note it down.
collect.call.line6: Thank you. I will send the payment link on WhatsApp so it takes only a minute.
collect.call.snoozed: Logged. This call comes back in 2 days.
collect.call.disputed: Logged. The problem is in your Inbox and reminders are paused.
collect.call.dispute_label: What does the customer say is wrong?
collect.call.dispute_effect: This pauses reminders and puts the problem in your Inbox to resolve.
collect.ib.title: Inbox
collect.ib.subtitle: {d} problems raised · {c} "already paid" claims
collect.ib.empty_body: When a customer says something is wrong with an invoice, or says they have already paid, it lands here and reminders for that invoice pause.
collect.ib.paused: Reminders for this invoice are paused until you resolve this.
collect.ib.claim_check: Check your bank account for this payment before you accept it.
collect.ib.s2b_within: Written objection within 15 days of delivery (MSMED Act §2(b)): the acceptance date may move to the day you resolve this, and the due date and any interest follow it.
collect.ib.s2b_outside: Raised {n} days after delivery, after the 15-day window in MSMED Act §2(b), so the acceptance date stays {date}.
collect.ib.s2b_prefill: Because the objection came within 15 days of delivery, the acceptance date below is set to today. Change it if you agreed another date.
collect.ib.credit_reason: Reason printed on the credit note
collect.ib.credit_effect: A numbered credit note is issued and the amount still owed drops by this much. No interest is counted for the days this problem was open.
collect.ib.credit_done: Credit note issued. It is listed under Resolved below.
collect.ib.mark_paid_effect: The invoice is closed as paid, reminders stop, and this is sealed in the invoice's record.
collect.ib.claim_ok_effect: Only do this if the money is in your bank. The invoice is closed as paid and reminders stop.
collect.ib.reject_effect: Reminders start again from where they paused. After saving, you can send the reply on WhatsApp or by email.
collect.ib.send_reply: Send your reply to the customer:

collect.ib.acceptance.label: Date the goods were accepted
collect.ib.acceptance.hint: Acceptance date (MSMED Act §2(b)): the due date is counted from it

collect.ib.credit_cap: From 0 to 45 days. The law caps agreed terms at 45 days (MSMED Act §15).
collect.ib.edit_effect: The due date is worked out again from these terms. No interest is counted for the days this problem was open.
collect.ib.edited: Invoice terms updated and the due date recalculated.
collect.ib.cn_issued: Credit note {cn} issued · no interest counted from {date} until it was resolved
collect.pay.title: Payments
collect.pay.subtitle: {n} waiting for your confirmation · nothing is marked paid until you confirm

collect.pay.import.label: Import your bank statement
collect.pay.import.hint: Bank reconciliation: matching credits in the statement to invoices

collect.pay.sample_hint: The sample is the demo business's October bank statement: an exact payment, a part payment, one payment for two invoices, one short by exactly 2%, an overpayment and an unknown deposit.
collect.pay.summary: {n} new credits read · {skipped} lines skipped · {dup} already imported, skipped
collect.pay.all_dupes: All {n} credits were already imported. Nothing changed.
collect.pay.skip.debit: money going out (a debit), not a payment to you
collect.pay.skip.bad_amount: the amount could not be read
collect.pay.skip.bad_date: the date could not be read
collect.pay.none_pending: Nothing waiting. Import a statement or add a payment by hand.
collect.pay.tds_line: Short by exactly {pct}% of the value before GST ({amount}). Possibly TDS deducted.
collect.pay.tds_ask: Ask the customer for the TDS certificate. Once you confirm, the shortfall can be recorded as tax deducted so it is not chased as unpaid.
collect.pay.over_note: More than the invoice owes. Only the amount owed is applied; the extra stays with this payment for you to refund or adjust.
collect.pay.unmatched_note: No invoice matched. Pick the invoice below if you know who paid, or reject it if it is not for a sale.
collect.pay.over_alloc: These amounts add up to more than the payment.
collect.pay.leftover: {amount} of this payment is not applied to any invoice.
collect.pay.locked: Not marked paid until you confirm
collect.pay.tds_done: {amount} recorded as TDS (not cash). This invoice will not be chased for it.
collect.pay.reject_effect: No invoice changes. If it came from the customer's "already paid" message, reminders start again.
collect.pay.tds_entry_note: Tax the customer deducted and deposited with the Income-tax Department. Collect the TDS certificate.
collect.pay.tds_open: {number} is still short by {amount}, exactly {pct}% of the value before GST. If the customer deducted TDS, record it so it is not chased.
collect.pay.manual_added: Added. Check the match below and confirm it.
collect.pay.let_match: Not sure: match it from the description
collect.fc.subtitle: The next {n} weeks from {date}
collect.fc.no_breach: Cash stays above your {amount} safety buffer for all {n} weeks.

collect.fc.buffer.label: Safety buffer
collect.fc.buffer.hint: Minimum cash reserve you want to keep

collect.fc.chart_title: Cash at the end of each week
collect.fc.chart_alt: Bar chart of cash at the end of each of the next {n} weeks. Lowest point {low}. Safety buffer {buffer}. First week below the buffer: {week}. The table below has every number.
collect.fc.no_expenses: No bills or salaries are entered yet, so money going out is zero. Add them to make this real.
collect.fc.gap_line: Cash at the end of that week: {closing}. That is {gap} below your safety buffer.
collect.fc.covers_week: Collecting these brings in {amount} before week {n} and covers it.
collect.fc.covers_part: Collecting all of these still leaves {amount} short in week {n}.
collect.fc.still_short: Even then, later weeks still fall up to {amount} below the buffer: the rest has to come from new sales, a delayed bill or credit.
collect.fc.nothing_covers: No unpaid invoice is expected late enough to help. The gap of {amount} has to come from new sales, a delayed bill or credit.
collect.fc.detail: What comes in and goes out
collect.fc.detail_all: What comes in and goes out, week by week
collect.fc.quiet: Nothing in or out this week.
collect.fc.after_window: {amount} more is expected after week {n}, so it is not in this table.
collect.fc.how: Money coming in: each unpaid invoice on its due date plus that customer's usual delay, or on the date they promised. Money going out: salaries, rent, bills and GST from your expenses. Each week's closing cash is the next week's opening cash.
collect.fc.vs_base: With these what-ifs, the first short week is {now}. Without them: {base}.
collect.ch.subtitle: {n} overdue invoices · {amount} · as of {date}
collect.ch.empty_body: Invoices appear here, best first, as soon as they pass their due date.
collect.ch.score_how: How priority is worked out, out of 100: up to 35 for the invoice's share of all money owed to you, up to 30 for days overdue (full at 90 days), 0, 5 or 15 for a grade A, B or C customer, and 20 more if collecting it covers the coming cash shortfall.

public.landing.kicker: For India's micro and small businesses
public.landing.h1: Get paid in full, on time, with the interest the law already owes you.
public.landing.problem: Small suppliers wait months to be paid, and most never use the MSMED Act that protects them. FullPay chases politely in English or Hindi, shows a cash shortage weeks ahead, and prepares the paperwork when a buyer still will not pay.
public.landing.demo_note: The demo is shared: other visitors may be clicking around too. Use Reset any time.
public.landing.diff_title: What FullPay does that others don't
public.landing.d_interest: Interest worked out the way the law says
public.landing.d_interest_body: Compound interest at 3 × the RBI Bank Rate in force on each day, monthly rests, 0% while a dispute is accepted, part-payments to interest first, with the source of every rate.
public.landing.d_answer: Customers can answer, not just be chased
public.landing.d_answer_body: Each customer gets a pay link: pay by UPI, say it is already paid, raise a problem, or promise a date. Any of these pauses the reminders.
public.landing.d_verify_body: Every invoice, reminder, payment and letter is sealed in a hash chain. The QR on a letter shows the buyer it is genuine and where to pay.
public.landing.d_forecast_body: A 13-week forecast from real due dates and each customer's habits, with the invoices that would close the gap.
public.landing.flow_title: From invoice to cash, without you lifting a finger
public.landing.flow_body: Every invoice moves through the same polite ladder: sent, reminded, paid — or chased further if it still hasn't. FullPay tracks where each one stands so you don't have to.
public.landing.demo_story: Fourteen customers, sixty-five invoices: some pay on time, some always pay late, one disputes, one deducts TDS. Reminders go out at 10:00 IST every day by themselves.
public.landing.demo_unavailable: The demo data is being reset. Try again in a minute.

public.pay.s37_before: Good to know: {business} is a Udyam-registered {cls} enterprise. For business buyers, section 37(2)(g) of the Income-tax Act, 2025 (earlier section 43B(h)) allows the deduction for purchases from micro and small enterprises in the year they are incurred only if payment is made within the MSMED Act time limit: the agreed date, which cannot be more than 45 days after acceptance, or 15 days after acceptance if nothing was agreed in writing. Paying by {date} keeps this expense deductible in the year it was incurred. General information, not tax advice.
public.pay.s37_after: Good to know: this invoice is past the MSMED Act time limit, so under section 37(2)(g) of the Income-tax Act, 2025 the expense is deductible only in the tax year in which it is actually paid. Paying before 31 March keeps it in the current year. General information, not tax advice.

public.int.gst_footnote: GST applies to interest for delayed payment as part of the value of the original supply (CGST Act s.15(2)(d); CBIC Circular 178/10/2022-GST, para 9). It becomes payable when the interest is received (s.12(6) / s.13(6)) and will be invoiced by a debit note under s.34(3); a registered buyer may claim input tax credit on it, subject to the usual conditions.
public.int.conventions_more: Interest is computed on the outstanding invoice amount including GST (our convention; the amount payable under s.15). Where the agreed credit period is longer than 45 days, interest runs from the day after the 45th day from acceptance, because s.15 caps agreed terms at 45 days; where no period was agreed in writing, it runs from the appointed day (the 16th day after acceptance).

pages.tour.label: Guided demo
pages.tour.dash.title: Monday morning at Arora Auto Components
pages.tour.dash.body: Harpreet makes brake parts in Ludhiana. This is what customers owe him, what is already late, and what should arrive this week.
pages.tour.follow.title: FullPay already knows who to chase today
pages.tour.follow.body: Every overdue invoice sits on a polite-to-firm ladder. Today's messages are drafted in the customer's language; Harpreet only taps send.
pages.tour.pay.title: What the customer sees
pages.tour.pay.body: One link per invoice: the amount, UPI QR, and three honest buttons: I've paid, promise a date, raise a problem. No login for the customer.
pages.tour.bank.title: Money comes in: match the bank statement
pages.tour.bank.body: Press "Load sample statement". FullPay reads every credit, finds the invoice and says why. Nothing is marked paid until someone confirms.
pages.tour.maker.title: The accountant prepares…
pages.tour.maker.body: Sign in as Simran, the accountant, and confirm any payment. It does not go through: it waits for the owner.
pages.tour.approve.title: …and the owner approves
pages.tour.approve.body: Back as Harpreet, approve it. The record keeps who prepared it and who approved it, and nobody can approve their own work.
pages.tour.verify.title: A letter anyone can check
pages.tour.verify.body: The demand letter quotes MSMED Act interest worked out across RBI rate changes. Its code proves the record has not been altered since.
pages.tour.analytics.title: Is it working?
pages.tour.analytics.body: Days to get paid, collection effectiveness, and the money that came in after a FullPay reminder: the numbers a bank or CA asks for.
pages.tour.import.title: Day one: bring the Tally book in
pages.tour.import.body: Press "Import from Tally / Vyapar / Excel", then "Try the Tally sample". Every line is checked before anything is saved.
pages.tour.end.title: That's FullPay
pages.tour.end.body: Every -Pay app helps you pay. FullPay is for getting paid, in full. Settings → Demo resets this world for the next visitor.

pages.search.short: Type at least 2 letters or digits.
pages.setup.title: Getting set up
pages.setup.business: Add your business name, address and GSTIN
pages.setup.business_why: They appear on every bill and letter.
pages.setup.upi_why: Every bill then carries a QR code your customer can pay from.
pages.setup.udyam_why: Needed to claim interest under the MSMED Act and to file on MSME Samadhaan.
pages.setup.customer_why: Or import them along with your bills.
pages.setup.invoice: Send or import your first bill
pages.setup.invoice_why: Reminders start from the due date on each bill.
pages.setup.bank_why: FullPay matches each payment to the right bill for you to confirm.
pages.setup.email_why: Ask whoever runs your FullPay server to add the email key. Until then, send reminders by WhatsApp or SMS.
collect.fu.receipt_note: Thank-you receipt for the payment you confirmed against {numbers}. Send it so the customer knows the money has reached you.
receipt.paid_one: Your invoice is now fully paid.
receipt.paid_all: These invoices are now fully paid.
collect.fu.no_email_mode: Email sending is not set up on this server, so nothing goes out on its own. Every message, including the ones that would be emailed automatically, waits here for one tap: WhatsApp, SMS or email from your own phone.
public.pay.plan_intro: Offer to pay this bill in 2 or 3 parts. {business} will look at it and reply here. Reminders pause until then.
public.pay.plan_mismatch: The parts must add up to exactly what is owed.
public.pay.plan_rules: The first part within 14 days, the last within 60 days, at least ₹500 each.
public.pay.plan_done: Sent. {business} will reply on this page; reminders are paused until then.
public.pay.state_plan_proposed: You offered to pay in {n} parts. Reminders are paused until {business} replies.
public.pay.state_plan_declined: {business} could not accept your plan to pay in parts. You can pay in full, offer different parts, or promise a date.
public.pay.state_plan_declined_reply: {business} could not accept your plan to pay in parts: “{reply}”
public.pay.state_plan_broken: A part was missed, so the plan to pay in parts has ended. Please pay what is still owed.
public.pay.plan_keep: Next part due by {date}. Pay each part on time and no reminders will come; if a part is missed, reminders start again.
public.pay.err_plan_date_order: Each part must be after today and after the part before it.
public.pay.err_plan_part_small: Each part must be at least ₹500.
public.pay.err_plan_first_far: The first part must be within 14 days.
public.pay.err_plan_too_far: The last part must be within 60 days.
public.pay.err_plan_sum: The parts must add up to exactly what is owed.
public.pay.err_plan_open: A plan to pay in parts is already in place for this bill.
public.pay.err_plan_blocked: Your payment claim is still being checked. Please wait for the reply.
collect.ib.plan_effect: If you approve, reminders stay paused while each part arrives on time, and the cash forecast expects each part on its date. A missed part ends the plan and reminders start again.
collect.ib.plan_paused: Reminders are paused until you answer.
collect.ib.plan_decline_effect: Reminders start again. The customer sees your reply on their link and can offer different parts.
collect.ib.plan_approved: Plan approved. The first part is now the promised date.
collect.hold.plan: Offer to pay in parts waiting for you
core.inv.paused_plan: Paused: customer offered to pay in parts
core.tl.paused_plan: Paused: the customer offered to pay in parts
core.tl.paused_plan_detail: Approve or decline the plan in your Inbox.
core.ev.plan_proposed: Customer offered to pay in parts
core.ev.plan_approved: Plan to pay in parts approved
core.ev.plan_declined: Plan to pay in parts declined
core.ev.plan_completed: Plan to pay in parts completed
core.ev.plan_broken: A part was missed: plan ended, reminders resumed
public.event.plan_approved: Plan to pay in parts approved
public.event.plan_declined: Plan to pay in parts declined
public.event.plan_completed: Plan to pay in parts completed
public.event.plan_broken: Plan to pay in parts ended (a part was missed)
collect.autocall.intro: FullPay calls each customer 7 days before a bill is due and 7 days after, in their language. This demo makes no real phone call: press Play to hear exactly what the customer would hear.
collect.autocall.unsupported: This browser cannot read the call aloud; the words are shown above.
